raw.details:
Tech Fusion-2026 | Vaish College of Engineering, Rohtak

About the Competition

A server is broken, the application is failing, and the evidence is waiting to be discovered. Who caused the crash?

Server Crash is a hands-on debugging challenge that tests participants' programming, troubleshooting, and server investigation skills.

Eligibility and Team Size

  • Team size: 1- 4 members.

  • Participants must bring their own laptops.

  • Programming languages: Java or Python.

Competition Format

Round 1: Find the Bug
Teams receive a broken application or server setup containing intentional problems. Examples include:

  • Incorrect configuration

  • API failure

  • Database connection issues

  • Port-related problems

  • Code bugs

  • Authentication failures

Teams must identify the issue and explain its cause.

Round 2: Debug the Server
Teams investigate a malfunctioning application, identify the underlying problem, and attempt to fix it. Every team receives the same problem and environment.

Internet access and external resources will be restricted or permitted according to the organizers' instructions.

Rules

  • Bring your own laptop and be prepared to work in Java or Python.

  • Follow the debugging environment and resource restrictions announced by the organizers.

  • Do not interfere with other teams or unauthorized systems.

  • Explain your findings and demonstrate your solution as instructed.

Find the bug. Diagnose the failure. Bring the server back to life.
